# Radio

The bare radio used inside `ChoiceList`. A native input, so arrow keys move between radios that share a name.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/radio)

## Usage

```tsx
<label>
  <Radio name="size" value="m" checked={size === 'm'} onChange={() => setSize('m')} />
  Medium
</label>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `…input` | `InputHTMLAttributes` | name, value, checked, onChange and the rest go to the &lt;input type="radio">. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Radio.module.css`
- `Radio.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
